INFORMATION GATHERING SYSTEM.

The source intake, evidence grading, contradiction check and conclusion pipeline for the site.

The Operating Loop

01

Collect

Gather source links, official pages, filings, public records, archives, reader leads, card forum submissions and daily public drops.

02

Classify

Tag each item by lane, actor, jurisdiction, date, evidence level, source class, affected deck/cards and missing records.

03

Grade Evidence

Separate official records, primary documents, reliable reporting, commentary, speculation, contradiction and unsupported claims.

04

Cross-check

Compare against counter-sources, corrections, older records, duplicate claims, outdated pages and source conflicts.

05

Connect

Route source material to clocks, cards, policies, institutions, people, think tanks, books, videos and user briefs.

06

Conclude

Produce conclusion, why it matters, evidence boundary, confidence, missing record, and next action.

07

Publish

Expose the conclusion through Daily Brief, Live Intel, card dossiers, risk clocks, search routes and downloads.

08

Review

Re-check stale conclusions, process reader corrections and downgrade or archive unsupported items.

Evidence Levels

Level 1: Lead

Interesting source or claim, not enough to conclude.

Level 2: Public mention

Speech, article, webpage, interview, report or claim with a visible source.

Level 3: Primary source

Official page, filing, legislation, public record, court material, regulator notice or original document.

Level 4: Implementation

Procurement, pilot, legal mandate, enforcement action, operational rollout or signed agreement.

Level 5: Convergence

Two or more systems connect, such as ID plus payments, health plus travel, AI plus public services.

Level 6: Lock-in signal

Opt-out becomes difficult, access becomes conditional, or infrastructure becomes unavoidable.

Quality Rules

  • No [object Object] visible in public pages.
  • No internal author notes, debug text or prompt text visible to users.
  • No source link, no ledger entry.
  • No conclusion without an evidence boundary.
  • No score movement without a dated source route.
  • No relationship entry presented as guilt or proof.
  • Every intake area needs action, boundary and correction route.
  • Every public brief needs next action and missing-record path.
